children: Vodafone Idea will now be offering free international roaming on select postpaid, prepaid and enterprise plans, simplifying earlier experiences of juggling multiple SIM cards, buying local or travel SIMs before departure.

Following its new campaign of “Vi Pe Sab Hain VIP,” the telecom service provider  has bundled free roaming into its plans for up to 3 trips in a year, with varying international data quotas and outgoing minutes of usage resulting in savings of up to ₹9,000 per year. The offer is valid for postpaid plans starting at ₹501, annual prepaid unlimited data plans and corporate plans starting at ₹451. The free roaming offer will be valid across over 170 countries globally.

Speaking about the launch of this offering, Avneesh Khosla, Chief Marketing Officer, Vi, said “Traditionally, international roaming has meant buying a pack or an additional purchase of a new local SIM or a travel eSIM and mostly perceived as expensive. We are taking a disruptive approach by making international roaming as a built-in benefit on our key Vi plans. It is a simple but significant shift from ‘buy roaming when you travel’ to ‘your Vi number travels with you for free.’”
Earlier, Vi had released a commercial, featuring Shah Rukh Khan where the Bollywood King highlights how the offering has been made free for all not just him.

“A few days ago, we told you Vi was changing – that this was not just a logo refresh, but a signal that something real was changing inside our company. A promise is only as good as the proof that follows. Today we deliver the first proof of that promise – solving a major consumer pain point,” said Abhijit Kishore, CEO of Vi, in a message to customers.

title: Vi announces free international roaming for select plans
